name: netnoreply
description: An echo to an unused LAN address: ARP goes unanswered, the ager clears the entry after 3 minutes, and no reply is counted. The control for netw5's echo. Only means anything at kernel.netprobe = 4.
command: modload bsdnetd bsdnet0 bsdnet1 bsdnet2 bsdnet3; sleep 300; dmesg | tail -8

requires.reason: the unused target is compiled in only at kernel.netprobe = 4
